name.description: Must match the filename — the pod refuses to load a definition where they disagree.

goal.description: What it is trying to achieve.

backstory.description: Context that shapes how it works.

model.description: Deprecated and ignored — set model_family instead.

model_family.description: Model family slug from the workspace list. If omitted, runs follow the current workspace default; the builder writes the displayed selection.

environment.description: Agent environment slug. If omitted, runs follow the current workspace default.

channel.description: Channel the agent posts its output to.

agents_squad.description: Other agents this one may hand work to.
